Image 2 is a plain grey 3D render of one heavy character standing in an A-pose, seen from the front: a purple padded jacket and hood, grey-slate armour plates on the chest and forearms, a cream belt, near-black trousers with grey knee pads, a helmet with a visor slot, a mask over the lower face, dark gloves and boots. Redraw image 2 as a finished flat-lit costume drawing in exactly the style of image 1, keeping the SAME pose, framing, proportions, silhouette (the same slim legs, the same arms, the same head size) and every garment edge of image 2 exactly where it is, pixel for pixel (it will be projected back onto the 3D model, so NOTHING may move or be resized), and its colours (muted purple, grey-slate, near-black, cream) as flat local fills. Plain flat mid-grey background, no text, no ground shadow.
